scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix residefix-server && npm install --prefix residefix-client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix residefix-server" "npm run dev --prefix residefix-client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix residefix-server && npm run lint --prefix residefix-client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix residefix-server && npm test --prefix residefix-client
